scope: Cleanup-timeout regression against the bounded interim measurement script, not the original b4 runtime or whole baseline. Owned processes and status are mocked; no real child process or listener starts.
assertions: Fake profiler wait raises the exact TimeoutExpired instance with a five-second timeout while the original CalledProcessError is active. Main propagates that first cleanup failure and preserves the original exception context without suppression. Server and sink are still killed and reaped; the completed loadgen is not restarted or killed. The profiler wait remains uncertain and its returncode is None; this test does not claim the timed-out profiler was reaped.
review: The finally loop handles OSError and TimeoutExpired separately for each known Popen owner, preserves the first error, attempts all remaining owners, then raises the first error. No unknown PID operation, hidden retry, Rust/runtime change, or change to normal cumulative/load CPU fields is introduced.
normalization: Replace repository prefix with <repo> and local user home with <user-home> in logs; retain portable Python interpreter source directives unchanged.
